name: Family van
short: The high-roof van most families and small groups travel the island in.
summary: A high-roof van with forward-facing seats for families, friends and small groups who would rather travel together than in two cars.

features.title: Everyone in one vehicle
features.body: Up to eight travellers and their bags, so the conversation does not split across two cars and two drivers.

features.title: Easy for children
features.body: A high roof to stand up in, wide sliding doors and child seats included, fitted before you arrive.

features.title: Space for the extras
features.body: Pushchairs, surfboards and duty-free all fit. Tell us what you are bringing and we will confirm it rides inside.

included: Driver's meals and rooms on multi-day hires

questions.a: Yes, in every van at no extra cost. Tell us the ages and weights when you enquire and the seats are fitted before pick-up.

questions.q: We are nine people. Do we need two vehicles?
questions.a: Usually a mini coach is simpler and costs less than two vans. Tell us your numbers and luggage and we will suggest the right fit.
